description: Scaffold the npm-workspaces monorepo root so both apps can be installed, linted, tested, and built from the repo root. Independent of other FEATs except that FEAT-002/003/004 depend on it (root scripts + workspace resolution). No app code yet; this establishes the shell and the CI-facing root scripts.
steps: Create root package.json at c:\Users\Gtvkun\Documents\GitHub\brewlite-a2\package.json with: "private": true, "name": "brewlite-a2", "workspaces": ["apps/*"], "engines": { "node": ">=20" }, and scripts that CI calls and that fan out to every workspace: "lint": "npm run lint --workspaces --if-present", "test": "npm run test --workspaces --if-present", "build": "npm run build --workspaces --if-present". (Scripts use bare npm inside package.json — that is fine; only the interactive PowerShell shell needs npm.cmd.)

Extend (do NOT replace) c:\Users\Gtvkun\Documents\GitHub\brewlite-a2\.gitignore: keep existing node_modules/.next/dist/.env lines and append coverage/, *.tsbuildinfo, apps/api/dist/, *.log, and Prisma generated client paths if generated into source. Keep .env ignored.
Run `npm.cmd install` from the repo root to generate package-lock.json and the workspace node_modules (apps/* empty for now is acceptable — install must still succeed).
acceptance_criteria: Root package.json declares workspaces apps/* and lint/test/build scripts that fan out with --workspaces --if-present.
`npm.cmd install` from repo root exits 0 and creates c:\Users\Gtvkun\Documents\GitHub\brewlite-a2\package-lock.json.
.gitignore still contains node_modules, .next, dist, .env and is only extended, not rewritten.
verification: Run `npm.cmd install` from c:\Users\Gtvkun\Documents\GitHub\brewlite-a2 and confirm exit 0 and package-lock.json exists.
Run `npm.cmd run lint` and `npm.cmd run test` and `npm.cmd run build` from root and confirm they exit 0 (no-op with --if-present while apps are empty).
findings: Toolchain: Node v24.15.0 local / npm 11.12.1; CI pins Node 20 LTS (.nvmrc=20, engines.node>=20). Root package.json: private, name brewlite-a2, workspaces [apps/*], scripts lint/test/build fan out via `npm run <s> --workspaces --if-present` (bare npm inside package.json is fine; only interactive PowerShell needs npm.cmd/npx.cmd). package-lock.json created at repo root by `npm.cmd install` (exit 0; audited 1 package, 0 vulnerabilities). .gitignore extended additively (kept node_modules/.next/dist/.env; appended coverage/, *.tsbuildinfo, apps/api/dist/, *.log, apps/api/node_modules/.prisma/, apps/api/src/generated/). GOTCHA for FEAT-002+: while apps/* is EMPTY, `npm run lint|test|build` exits 1 with 'No workspaces found!' — npm's --if-present suppresses missing SCRIPTS, not the zero-matching-workspace error. This is transient and self-resolves the moment the first app package lands under apps/*. Decision (confirmed with parent, option A): do NOT mask exit codes (`|| exit 0`/`|| true`) and do NOT add a placeholder app — masking would permanently hide real lint/test/build failures once apps exist. Acceptance criteria (install exit 0 + lockfile + additive .gitignore) all pass. See .agents/tasks/verification.md.
